_comment: dose-cite-v4 verdict fixtures, one named group per clause of the rule, plus every adversarial pair from the three M6 re-reviews (probes-round-1..3) and the reviewers' benign lists with their actual v4 outcome (cost). Each case: a reply + a source set (a name from sources.json, or an inline array) -> the expected verdict fields. WITHHELD stands for lookup-guard.js WITHHELD_BANNER and a displayText of exactly NO_EVIDENCE for LOOKUP_NO_EVIDENCE_TEXT. A note field says why a case matters or what it costs. The canonical rule is src/triage/lookup-guard.js; the triage repo vendors it and asserts identity group by group.
